description: This is a shell script file containing tests for Git's handling of line endings (CRLF/LF), especially focusing on features like autocrlf and safecrlf configurations. It includes setup commands, test cases, and functions to validate Git's behavior with line endings under various configurations.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a file contains CR characters by transforming '' (ASCII 13) into 'Q' and searching for 'Q'.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters in files by calling respective functions (_cr and remove_cr) and replacing the file content in-place.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Transforms '' (CR, ASCII 13) into 'Q' and removes newlines, used for comparing file contents after line ending transformations.
